test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

I had heard of __henpecked husbands__ and now, I felt that I saw one.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'Oppressed husband'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"henpecked husband"** refers to a man who is constantly being nagged or dominated by his wife. (पत्नी द्वारा सताया हुआ पति)

 
 
• **Example: **John is such a henpecked husband; his wife never lets him make any decisions on his own.
 
 
 
• **"Oppressed husband" **is a term used to describe a husband who is controlled or subdued, especially by his wife. (दबाया हुआ पति)
 
 
• **Example: **In old movies, the oppressed husband is often portrayed as someone who can never stand up for himself.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Controlling husband** (नियंत्रित करने वाला पति): A husband who tries to control or dominate his wife.

 
 
• **Example: **Emma felt suffocated because her controlling husband would not let her meet her friends.
 
 
 
• **Bossy husbands** (हुक्म चलाने वाला पति): A husband who is overly authoritative or commanding.
 
 
• **Example: **She had a hard time dealing with her bossy husband who always told her what to do.
 
 
 
• **Dominating husbands** (प्रभुत्व जमाने वाला पति): A husband who exercises control or influence over his wife in a forceful manner.
 
 
• **Example: **Her dominating husband left her with very little freedom in their marriage.
